title: Agent Workbench
subtitle: Configure your Agents around the work you want to do.

freshStart.title: Fresh v4 workspace
freshStart.body: This generation starts with {{count}} official templates and an empty personal library. Previous settings are not imported; fork a template or create a new Agent here.

library.title: Agent library
library.subtitle: Official templates and your Agent setups
library.deleteConfirmBody: It can no longer be edited or used for new conversations. Existing conversation history is preserved.

template.capabilityHint: Add or remove capabilities for your work. Saving creates your own Agent and keeps the official preset available.
template.hostUnavailable: This template includes capabilities that are unavailable on the current Nomi-core host. Forking stays blocked until a real owner is available.
template.zeroToolBody: No capability, Skill, MCP, workspace, Coding context, or hidden capability search is constructed.

fields.name: Name
fields.chatModelRouteUnavailable: Configure an available chat model before saving or trying this Agent.

status.noRevision: This draft has no saved Revision yet.
status.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Saving applies them to new conversations.
status.revisionImmutable: Saved revisions are immutable; edits create the next Revision.

capabilities.catalogUnavailable: No usable implementation of this capability is available on this installation.
capabilities.unavailableReason: This installation does not currently provide an executable owner for this capability, so it cannot be selected.

resources.pickerHint: Choose actual product resources only. The system securely resolves permissions, paths, credentials and runtime parameters.
resources.dependencyHint: Matching resources appear after you select {{resource}}.
resources.selectionHint: This resource is used for this launch and can be changed before the next one.
resources.emptyOptions: No available resource. Configure one before starting.
resources.loadFailed: The resource list could not be loaded. Check its configuration page.
resources.bindingPolicyTitle: Choose actual resources when using the Agent
resources.bindingPolicyBody: An Agent only declares its capability boundary and required resource kinds. Each conversation, companion, or automation target selects and manages its own knowledge bases, workspace, and connections.

preview.emptyBody: Preview resolves the draft without writing a Preset, Revision, Session, or external Effect.

continuation.title: Exact compatibility or explicit fork
continuation.body: A compatible frozen Snapshot continues the same Session. An unavailable executor leaves history read-only and requires an explicit new-ID fork with a self-contained semantic base; Runtime-private handles and Effects are never replayed.

remoteToken.continuation: Rotate or revoke fences only new Remote request admission. Existing Sessions remain unchanged; a replacement token must resolve to the same owner and explicitly submit the original AgentSession ID.

test.realEffectWarning: Test saves current changes when needed and creates an ordinary persistent conversation. Tools and external effects are not simulated; required resources come from the real test context.
test.inputPlaceholder: Enter the first test message for this Agent…

errors.title: Agent Workbench could not complete the operation
errors.presetCapabilitiesLoadFailed: The selected Agent's capabilities could not be loaded. Retry or choose another Agent.

session.title: Agent Session
session.deleteConfirm: Delete this Session permanently? Its transcript, projections, Runtime binding, checkpoint, and Session-owned resources will be removed.
session.deletedBody: This AgentSession has crossed the irreversible deletion fence. Its transcript cannot be viewed, continued, observed, forked, or restored.
session.continuationRequired: The frozen Snapshot is not executable on the current stack. History remains read-only; continue only by explicitly forking a new AgentSession.
session.empty: No transcript projections have been committed yet.
session.inputPlaceholder: Send an ordinary Turn to this Session…

workbench.missingReason: The source of this capability is missing. Remove it, or restore the corresponding plugin before using it.
workbench.builtinReason: This official built-in capability is not connected correctly, which is a release-integrity failure in the current version. Update or repair the application, or remove it to continue editing the rest of the configuration.
workbench.pluginReason: Check that the plugin or connection is enabled, fully configured, and has an available runtime.
workbench.unavailableSummary: {{count}} capabilities need attention. Remove them to continue with the available configuration.
workbench.libraryHint: Browse by task, then add your selections together. New capabilities activate on demand; you can change this anytime.
workbench.emptyHint: Choose knowledge, development, web or other capabilities to fit the work you want it to do.
workbench.noResultsHint: Try another keyword, category or status filter.
workbench.removalHint: Removing a capability withdraws it from this Agent after saving. Choose specific workspaces, knowledge bases and other resources when using the Agent.
workbench.officialHint: Start with a preset and make it yours
workbench.myHint: Prepare the right Agent for your work
workbench.customizeHint: Adjust capabilities and save your own Agent. The official preset stays available.
workbench.saveHint: New conversations will use this configuration after saving.
